newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates steady at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates steady at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates remained steady at mid-session on Wednesday as the central bank's recent issues of negotiable certificates of deposits mopped up excess money in the market, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 4.750 percent against Tuesday's 4.753 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.75 against 4.70-4.75.
Dealers expected the rates to stop their recent slide with rising liquidity demand ahead of Friday's Mid-Autumn festival.
In the bond market, the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.6700-5.6725 against 5.7000. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
